rationale: Nathanaël brings deep embedded systems and IoT expertise with a strong hardware-software integration background, while Jack is building hardware products with ML at Roomform and has complementary ECE and machine learning knowledge. They share overlapping tech stacks (Python, Verilog/VHDL) and could explore how embedded systems architecture and audio-processing hardware might benefit from each other's domain experience.
intro_message: Nathanaël BLAVO-BALLARIN, meet Jack Edelist — you both have hardware-software integration backgrounds and overlapping skills in low-level languages; Jack's ML-hardware work at Roomform could benefit from Nathanaël's IoT and embedded systems depth.
